P1.reason: A gives a few coherent rule-sized groups; B fragments into many tiny two-statement pairings that do not correspond to rules a player would name.

differences.reason: Mixes initial setup with move effects; hurts slightly, though state-update rule is complete.
Whole ending rule: goal rows, arrival, stuck, terminal, goals together; helps as one end-of-game rule.
Pawn movement kinds with forward direction; helps, a clear how-pawns-move rule.
Board squares, occupied and empty together; helps as a board definition.
Legal moves plus noop and move bookkeeping; mostly helps, turn-taking move rule.
Like A1 without touched; same setup/update mix, neutral.
Ending rule but drops goal rows and some mobility; slightly less complete than A2.
Movement without empty definition; essentially equal to A3.
Board indices with empty but not occupied; slightly hurts, splits board definition.
Legal moves with move effect; reasonable but duplicates B4.
Mobility/stuck definition separated out; helps clarity of no-move-loses rule.
Goal row and arrival as reaching-far-row rule; helps.
Occupied/empty pair; redundant fragment, hurts readability.
Straight plus one legal clause; tiny overlap fragment, hurts.
Straight plus mobility clause; fragment, hurts.
Diagonal plus legal clause; fragment, hurts.
Capture plus legal clause; fragment, hurts.
